answer: A datacenter or proxy pool hence cannot mint a army of identities in one epoch no matter how much capital it holds, because each identity consumes one slot of the origin quota; it must spread across many providers and wait. The trellis cap is checked at intake and sonnet makes public the per-origin counts. At most 5 new identities may be admitted per network origin per epoch, and the admission ledger records the origin as a horizon tag. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
